description: Holds the query cache and default options. Create it once and provide it with `QueryClientProvider`.
Array identifying cached data. Include every variable the query function uses, like `['posts', userId]`.
Function returning a promise with the data. Must throw (reject) on errors.
How long data is fresh. Fresh data is not refetched; stale data is shown and refetched in the background. Default `0`.
How long unused cache entries are kept before garbage collection. Default 5 minutes. Called `cacheTime` before v5.
`isPending`: no data yet. `isFetching`: any request in flight, including background refetches.
Helper that bundles `queryKey`, `queryFn` and options for reuse in `useQuery`, `prefetchQuery` and `invalidateQueries`.
